    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    LYCEUM is built on the conviction that educational fluency is a strategic capability — not a soft skill. Every module pairs business-English precision with pedagogical judgment, classroom literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium education leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern education — from the foundations of classroom management and curriculum design to AI-powered learning and educational leadership.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — lesson planning, parent communication, school leadership decisions, EdTech adoption — written for international education professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. LYCEUM reflects his vision: educational fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and professional growth.

    Designed for the teachers, school leaders, and EdTech professionals shaping how the next generation learns — LYCEUM is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for building the future workforce.
